scenario: Multiple `on` clauses on the same call per LCCO.6.4 — each generates a separate synthetic sibling rule sharing the same correlation. Pin: a call with two `on` clauses compiles cleanly and produces two `$..._response_N` sibling rules.
rules_ds:
schema SensorReadReply scope ttl 1_h:
    corr: String
    code: Int

service sensor.read:
    kwarg entity_id: String
    response SensorReadReply

schema Trig scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    v: Int mutable

rule r:
    Trig t
->
    call sensor.read entity_id: t.entity_id cooldown: 1_min
        on response.code == 200:
            log info "ok"
        on response.code == 404:
            log info "not found"
